Longshore and Harbor Workers' Compensation Act (LHWCA) is a federal workers' compensation program that provides medical and disability benefits to covered workers who are injured on the job. The program provides a comprehensive system for providing workers' compensation benefits to covered workers, and it is an essential component of the U.S. workers' compensation system.
